annotations.title: Check a brand: who it is, where it stands, what comes next

description: Look up how AI answers talk about a brand, who it loses to, verified product facts, and AI crawler blocks. Call this first for brand positioning, competitor research, AI visibility, or before writing copy about a brand. Takes a website (best), brand name, or brd_ id. Returns data.kind (measured, thin, unplaced, which, unseen): for measured brands, Recommended share (with share_named detail) per market, top rivals, weakest topic, and where recommendation share falls short; for ambiguous names (which), the candidate list without reading; for thin/unseen, coverage status and next steps. Up to three query_metrics reads. No brand score. Free.

subject.description: the brand's website (best: it settles which company), its name, or a brd_ id
